listing.title: Plumb: Marble Tilt Puzzle
listing.short: Tilt the board and roll every marble into the hole of its own colour.
listing.full:
Plumb is a calm logic puzzle about gravity.

Swipe to tilt the board and every marble rolls at once, until a wall, the edge or another marble stops it. A marble drops into a hole of its own colour the moment it rolls over one. Square pits swallow any marble, so plan the route before you tip.

One gesture moves everything, which is what makes four directions surprisingly deep: every move is a small chain of consequences to read before you make it.

- Every level checked by a solver and scored against the fewest moves possible, each a little harder than the last
- Three stars for the fewest moves, with a hint that shows where every marble would land
- Undo and restart any time. No timers, no lives, no energy
- A quiet, tactile look and an ambient soundtrack, with sound, music and vibration you can switch off
- Plays offline
listing.release_notes: First release: levels that get steadily harder, hints that preview the next tilt, and a calm ambient soundtrack.
